6211.de: Bust portrait of a young woman in a slight turn to the left. In folk costume - wearing a white blouse with a red bodice, on the head a kabimüts.

6212.d: Vana pikajuukselise lõughabemega mehe täisprofiil paremale. Rinnapilt. Foon must.
6212.de: Full profile of an old man with long hair and a pointed beard, facing right. Chest-length portrait. Black background.

6214.d: Hallipäise mehe poolfiguur poolprofiilis vasakule. Käed ristatud rinnale. Taevas koidupunast valgustatud.
6214.de: Half-figure of a grey-haired man in half-profile to the left. Arms crossed on the chest. The sky lit with the red of dawn.

6215.dm: lehe laius: 59.4 cm; lehe kõrgus: 71.0 cm
6215.d: Kikkhabemega mehe rinnapilt profiilis paremale; tumedas kuues, punase õiega nööpaugus. Taust sinkjas-must. Ovaalne.
6215.de: Bust portrait of a goateed man in profile to the right; in a dark coat, with a red flower in the buttonhole. Background bluish-black. Oval.

6222.dm: lehe laius: 63.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 80.0 cm
6222.d: Pruunide juuste, põsk- ja tugeva piiratud lõughabemega kaugusesse vaatava mehe poolfiguur pöördega vasakule. Foon punane. Kujutis ovaalis.
6222.de: Half-figure of a man with brown hair, sideburns and a full trimmed beard, gazing into the distance, with a turn to the left. Background red. Image in an oval.

6223.d: Vanema mehe rindportree poolprofiiis paremale. Tumedais juusteis ja pöetud lõuahabemes halli vinet.
6223.de: Bust portrait of an older man in half-profile facing right. Dark hair and a trimmed goatee with gray streaks.

6224.d: Esiplaanil murupind üksikute madalate pääsastega, paremal diagonaalis pildi keskele suunduv püst-tara, mille ääres põõsas-puid, keskel suurem sopiline veekogu, mille madalail kallastel segametsa.
6224.de: In the foreground a grassy area with a few low junipers, on the right a diagonal upright fence leading to the centre of the picture, with bushes and trees along it, in the middle a larger indented body of water, with mixed forest on its low banks.

6458.d: Tumedapäise kissis silmadega mehe portree otsevaates, piip hambus. Ekspressiivne maalikäsitlus, erksad toonid: heleroheline kuub, sinine särk lipsuga. Diagonaalsete laiade pintslitõmmetega maalitud roosa foon.
6458.de: Portrait of a dark-haired man with narrowed eyes, frontal view, a pipe between his teeth. Expressive painting style, bright tones: a light green coat, a blue shirt with a tie. Pink background painted with wide diagonal brushstrokes.

6459.d: Geomeetriline kompositsioon, mille keskmes ruumiliselt kujutatud avatud (tubaka)karp, sinine silinder selle taga, ees paremas nurgas piip. Taustal läbisegi selgepiirilised geomeetrilised ja abstraktsed kujundid maalitud siledapinnaliselt, kohati lühikeste pintslitõmmetega.
6459.de: A geometric composition, in the centre of which is spatially depicted an open (tobacco) box, a blue cylinder behind it, in front on the right corner a pipe. In the background, mixed together, clearly outlined geometric and abstract shapes painted with smooth surfaces, in places with short brushstrokes.

6461.d: Geomeetrilistest kujunditest kompositsioon, mille keskmes sõõr mitmete ruumiliste kujunditega: ülal silinder, paremal kuubik, allpool kaks piipu. Sõõri läbivad diagonaaljooned tekitades ruumilisi lõikeid. Roosakasbeeź, hallikasroheline summutatud koloriit. Tihe spaatli, pintslikiri.
6461.de: A composition of geometric shapes, at the centre a circle with several spatial forms: at the top a cylinder, on the right a cube, below two pipes. Diagonal lines run through the circle creating spatial intersections. Pinkish-beige, greyish-green muted colouring. Dense palette-knife and brush work.

6464.d: Geomeetriliselt üldistatud, konstruktiivne, punastes toonides nägu valgete iiristega silmadega, kerges pöördes vasakule. Laubal ovaalne vari punasega. Mustas ülikonnas, kikilipsuga.
6464.de: A geometrically generalised, constructive face in red tones with eyes with white irises, in a slight turn to the left. On the forehead an oval shadow in red. In a black suit, with a bow tie.

6476.d: Konstruktivistlikus laadis kompositsioon kolme naisfiguuriga. Vasakul istuva naise rinnafiguur, tema ees sinine vaas ja korv värviliste keradega. Keskel seisev naine, parem käsi puusas ja paremal istuv naine selgvaates. Samas, läbi võlvkaare avaneb vaade linnale.
6476.de: A composition in constructivist style with three female figures. On the left the bust of a seated woman, in front of her a blue vase and a basket with colourful balls. In the middle a standing woman, right hand on hip, and on the right a seated woman seen frontally. In the same place, through an arched vault, a view of the city opens.

6478.d: Kolm figuuri kubistlikult geometriseeritud, ümbritsetud muusikariistade elementidega. Parempoolne naisfiguur suletud silmadega, vasak kinnastatud käsi ees, vasakpoolne figuur kollase ihutooniga, tagumine figuur tõmmu, punase mütsiga.
6478.de: Three figures in cubistically geometricised form, surrounded by elements of musical instruments. The figure on the right, a woman with closed eyes, gloved left hand in front; the figure on the left with yellow skin tone; the rear figure swarthy, wearing a red cap.

6479.d: Pikliku peaga kõrge nõgusa laubaga ja kõrge, veidi esileulatuva kuklaga, rohekashallide, eest sirgelt lõigatud juustega poisi portree poolprofiilis vasakule. Helesinised silmad kõrgete kulmukaartega, pika sirge, nõrga ninajuurega ninaga, tagasiulatuva lõuaga. Hallikassinises pluusis selle alt paistva punase kaelusega. Neutraalne erineva heledusega foon.
6479.de: Portrait, in half-profile facing left, of a boy with an elongated head, a high concave forehead and a high, slightly protruding back of the head, with greenish-grey hair cut straight at the front. Light blue eyes with high arched eyebrows, a long straight nose with a weak bridge, and a receding chin. Wearing a greyish-blue blouse with a red collar showing beneath it. Neutral background of varying lightness.

6480.d: Geomeetriliselt lihtsustatud kahe naise rinnafiguurid. Eespool, vasakul, roheliste, peadligi liibuvate, tagant patsina langevate juustega naine poolprofiilis paremale, helerohelises, kolmnurkse sisselõikega rüüs, tema seljataga pildivälja keskel kollaste juustega, langetatud pilguga, pead paremale (vaataja suhtes) kallutav naine sügava dekolteega hallikassinises kleidis. Tema õla juures ornažikaspunane kera. Fooniks värvilised geomeetrilised kujundid.
6480.de: Geometrically simplified bust figures of two women. In front, on the left, a woman with green hair, close to the head, falling into a braid at the back, in half-profile to the right, in a light green robe with a triangular cutout; behind her, in the centre of the picture field, a woman with yellow hair, with a lowered gaze, tilting her head to the right (in relation to the viewer), in a greyish-blue dress with a deep décolletage. Near her shoulder, an orange-red sphere. The background consists of coloured geometric shapes.

6481.d: Tumedal neutraalsel foonil kollakates ja pruunikates toonides modelleeritud askeetlikult teravate, karakteersete näojoontega, kergelt lainetavate helepruunide juustega, tumerohelises pluusis ning punaste triipudega tumesinise kikilipsuga mehe rinnaportree  enface, kerges pöördes vasakule, rohekate silmade, altkulmu uuriv-terav pilk suunatud vaatajale. Rinna kõrgusele tõstetud pikkade küüntega peenes paremas käes roheline pliiats. Teravad tundelised punased huuled, piklik lõuapartii, veidi kongus nina.
6481.de: A bust portrait, en face, of a man modelled in yellowish and brownish tones against a dark neutral background, with ascetically sharp, characterful facial features, slightly wavy light-brown hair, wearing a dark green blouse and a dark blue bow tie with red stripes, in a slight turn to the left, with greenish eyes and a probing, sharp gaze directed at the viewer from under his brows. In his slender right hand, raised to chest height, with long fingernails, a green pencil. Sharp, sensitive red lips, an elongated jawline, a slightly hooked nose.

6482.d: Tumedast foonist eraldub sulava siluetiga heledas särgis, tumeda kaelasideme, kaabu ja prillidega mehe poolfiguur. Paremas käes pintsel, vasemas palett, millel mitmesuguseid värvitoone.
6482.de: From a dark background emerges, with a melting silhouette, the half-figure of a man in a light shirt, dark necktie, hat and glasses. In his right hand a brush, in his left a palette with various colour tones.

6485.d: Vasakult üks seljaga ning üks näoga istuv naisfiguur alasti, vastavalt punase ja musta riidepalakaga käes. Paremal seljaga veerandpöördes alasti seisev naisfiguur valge riidega käes. Vasakul ja keskel istuvate naiste taga tumedad sinakashallid puukroonid, ülal pilvine taevas. Naiste kehad ja riidetükid on maalitud üldistavas laadis, tugevasti valgust ja varju rõhutades.
6485.de: From the left, one seated female figure with her back turned and one facing forward, nude, holding a red and a black piece of cloth respectively. On the right, a nude female figure standing in a quarter-turn with her back turned, holding a white cloth. Behind the seated women on the left and in the center, dark bluish-gray treetops, above a cloudy sky. The women's bodies and pieces of cloth are painted in a generalized manner, strongly emphasizing light and shadow.

6498.d: Ees paremal, saanis naine ja mees. Vasakul, künka varjus, ebamäärane, sinises rüüs, kaamete nägudega figuuride grupp. Taga, künka harjal taluhooned.
6498.de: In front on the right, a woman and a man in a sleigh. On the left, in the shadow of a hill, a vague group of figures in blue robes with pale faces. Behind, on the crest of the hill, farm buildings.

6570.d: Metsamaastiku eelplaanil rohul magav naine põllel istuva lapsega, vasakult kaks lähenevat ingel-last, teisel lillepärjake käes, taga paremal rohelise metsa all veisekari.
6570.de: In the foreground of a forest landscape, a woman sleeping on the grass in a field with a child sitting nearby, from the left two approaching angel-children, one holding a little wreath of flowers, behind on the right a herd of cattle under a green forest.

6615.d: Esiplaanil (peaaegu pool maalipinnast) rohekates toonides jõgi (Narva), millel kolm sõudepaati, ilmselt sõjameestega (ajaloost). Keskel horisontaalselt heledatooniline kindlus, mille jalal rohelist. Taevas ühtlaselt lilla.
6615.de: In the foreground (almost half of the painting's surface) a river (Narva) in greenish tones, on which three rowing boats, apparently with soldiers (from history). In the middle, horizontally, a light-toned fortress, with green at its base. The sky uniformly purple.

6619.d: Esiplaanil vasakul kaljune rannariba; keskel ja paremal vesi. Vastas järsk ja kaljune kallas. Kõrgemail tippudel lumelaike.
6619.de: In the foreground on the left a rocky strip of shore; in the centre and on the right water. Opposite a steep and rocky bank. Patches of snow on the higher peaks.

6675.de: View of a lawn with solitary trees.

6678.d: Keskel kohal kaks mehefiguuri, mõlemate vaade suunatud vasakule. Vasakpoolsel, habemega, pruunis pikk-kuues vanamehel vasakus käes vastu rinda tõstetud müts. Noormehe figuur toetub, kergelt ettekummardudes, väravale. Koloriit tume.
6678.de: In the middle ground, two male figures, both gazing to the left. The left one, bearded, an old man in a long brown coat, holds his cap raised to his chest in his left hand. The young man's figure leans, slightly bending forward, against the gate. Dark colour scheme.

6679.d: Istuva mehe kolmveerandfiguur, profiilis vasakule. Parem jalg üle põlve tõstetud. Kõrge laup, peenejooneline nina, satäänid juuksed ülepea kammitud. Seljas tume ülikond. Maalitud etüüdlikult.
6679.de: Three-quarter figure of a seated man, in profile to the left. Right leg raised over the knee. High forehead, finely drawn nose, sleek hair combed back over the head. Wearing a dark suit. Painted in a sketch-like manner.

6820.d: Ees keskel kirju kukk. Vasakul suurel rohelisel lehel kaks õuna. Paremal seened. Üsna laua äärel vuugid, lillakas savipott ja pudel. Taga keskel vaas paari lilleoksaga.
6820.de: In the front centre a mottled rooster. On the left, on a large green leaf, two apples. On the right, mushrooms. Right at the edge of the table, joints, a purplish clay pot and a bottle. Behind, in the centre, a vase with a couple of flower branches.

6890.d: Öises maastikus vasakul preestri kuju, paremal kaks väikest kuuske ja mäenõlv. Taamal kõrge ohvritule ümber valges riietuses figuure.
6890.de: In a nocturnal landscape, a priest's figure on the left, on the right two small spruces and a hillside. In the distance, figures in white clothing around a tall sacrificial fire.

6891.d: Kompositsioon fantastiliste lendavate loomade ja figuuridega põrandal.
6891.de: A composition with fantastic flying animals and figures on the floor.

6901.d: Esiplaanil karjavärav, paremal kooguga kaev, vasakul taluhoone. Taamal maja ees naise figuur.
6901.de: In the foreground a herd gate, on the right a well with a sweep, on the left a farm building. In the distance a woman's figure in front of the house.

6902.d: Heleda draperii foonil istuv naisakt otsevaates, vasak käsi ümber paabulinnu, parem süles. Naise lühikeste tumedate juustega pea kummardunud alla paremale, pilk linnul. Parem jalg viidud vasaku taha. Taustal paremal punane, vasakul sinakas, all rohekassinine draperii. Maalitud siledalt, vorme üldistavalt.
6902.de: Against a light drapery background a seated female nude in frontal view, left hand around a peacock, right hand in her lap. The woman's head, with short dark hair, bent down to the right, gaze on the bird. Right leg placed behind the left. In the background, red on the right, bluish on the left, greenish-blue drapery below. Painted smoothly, generalising the forms.

6907.d: Summutatud murtud toonides, detaile ning värvivarjundeid tumeda jämeda kontuuriga piiratud vormide ültooni sulatavalt maalitud väikelinna maastik, vaadatud kõrgest vaatepunktsist. Esiplaanil all hall rohekassinine jõgi kahe kõrvuti ujuva väikese purjepaadiga. Keskplaanil jõe kaldal oranžikas-punaste katustega madalad kiviehitised: vasakul hoone neljatahulise tornikesega selle taga; keskel astmelise katusega hoone ning neljatahuline tornikene, ühendatud väravaavaga madala müüriga; paremal katusega madal sammastik terrassil. Hoonete taga kaks suurt lehtpuud. Tagaplaanil künkal tihedasti paigutatud kaitsetornidega keskaegne linnus.
6907.de: A small-town landscape painted in muted broken tones, with details and colour shades melting into an overall tone within forms bordered by a dark thick contour, viewed from a high viewpoint. In the foreground below, a grey greenish-blue river with two small sailboats floating side by side. In the middle ground on the riverbank, low stone buildings with orangish-red roofs: on the left a building with a four-sided little tower behind it; in the middle a building with a stepped roof and a four-sided little tower, connected by a low wall with a gateway opening; on the right a low colonnade with a roof on a terrace. Behind the buildings, two large deciduous trees. In the background on a hill, a medieval fortress with densely arranged defence towers.

6927.d: Noore mehe portree poolpöördes vasakule. Peas laia äärega tumesinine kaabu, ninal sinises toonis antud raamidega prillid, mille klaasid varjavad silmi. Sirged, teravalt väljajoonistuvad nina ja suu. Huulte vahel põlev sigaret. Seljas rohekassinine mantel. Nägu antud erivärviliste pintslilöökidega. Foon kollane ja kollakasroheline.

6930.d: Noore naise rinnaportree, pea pöördes paremale. Tugevad põsesarnad, teravalt etteulatuv kandiline lõug. Suuümber kerge naeratuse vine. Peas must, nn. pottkübar, heleda ilustisega paremal; seljas must, valge kraega kleit.
6930.de: Bust portrait of a young woman, head turned to the right. Strong cheekbones, a sharply protruding angular chin. A faint trace of a smile around the mouth. On her head a black so-called bowler hat, with light-coloured trimming on the right; wearing a black dress with a white collar.

6932.d: Kolmnurkne dekoratiivne kompositsioon nelja naisaktiga. Sinistes, rohekates, punakates toonides geomeetrilistest kujunditest interjööris vasakul külgvaates põlvitav naine, käed üles ette situtatud. Keskel oranžile padjale nõjatuv figuur, ülakeha tõstetud, paremas tõstetud käes sinine pudel. Parempoolne seisev figuur poolseglvaates, vasakus käes sinine peeker. Tagaplaanil keskel, oranžis rombikujulises avas seisev figuur.
6932.de: Triangular decorative composition with four female nudes. In blue, greenish and reddish tones, in an interior of geometric shapes, on the left a kneeling woman in profile, hands raised forward. In the centre a figure leaning on an orange pillow, upper body raised, in the raised right hand a blue bottle. On the right a standing figure in half profile, in the left hand a blue goblet. In the background in the centre, a figure standing in an orange rhombus-shaped opening.

6943.d: Esiplaanil keskel, kogu vertikaalse kesktelje ulatuses mänd, millest vasakul seljaga vaataja poole, valges, kirjatud allserva ja varrukatega ning vööga kleidis, pikkade tumedate patsidega neiu, parem käsi silmile tõstetud, merele vaatamas. Mere kaldalt tõuseb paremale mäkke liivarand, kaetud lillade taimedega. Ülal helesinine taevas, paremal nurgas pastelsetes toonides kontsentrilistes ringides maalitud suur, kollast valgust kiirgav päike.
6943.de: In the foreground in the centre, spanning the entire vertical central axis, a pine tree, to the left of which, with her back to the viewer, a girl with long dark braids, wearing a white dress with a patterned lower hem and sleeves and a belt, her right hand raised to her eyes, looking at the sea. From the seashore a sandy beach rises to a hill on the right, covered with purple plants. Above, a light blue sky, in the right corner a large sun painted in pastel-toned concentric circles, radiating yellow light.

7010.d: Arhitektuurielementidest kombineeritud ruumilise muljega kompositsioon. Valdavalt gooti arhitektuuri kuuluvad tugipiilarid, kõrged teravkaarelised akna- ja ukseorvad, portaalid, treppide, tahukate motiivid läbisegi. Geomeetriliste kujundite vahele tungivad vasakult valgusvihud, moodustades keskele, aimatavale põrandale valguslaike. Motiivide vahel tagapool kaks figuuridepaari, eespool paremal silinderkübaras fotograafi poolfiguur külgvaates. Kompositsiooni keskmes pruunid, beežid toonid, ülal tagapool hallikassinised kõrgusse pürgivad kujundid.
7010.de: A composition combining architectural elements with a spatial impression. Predominantly Gothic architectural buttresses, tall pointed-arch window and door openings, portals, motifs of stairs and blocks intermingle. Beams of light penetrate from the left between the geometric shapes, forming patches of light in the centre on a suggested floor. Behind the motifs, two pairs of figures, and in front on the right the half-figure of a photographer in a top hat, seen from the side. In the centre of the composition brown, beige tones, above in the background greyish-blue shapes striving upward.

7083.d: Vasakul ja paremal avatud tiibuksed, seinal peegel, laes kroonlühter.
7083.de: Open double doors on the left and right, a mirror on the wall, a chandelier on the ceiling.

7084.d: Esiplaanil plangu taga  majade vaheline õu lahtise trepi ja pumbaga. Taamal majad ja Pauluse kiriku torn.
7084.de: In the foreground, behind a fence, a courtyard between houses with an open staircase and a pump. In the distance houses and the tower of St. Paul's Church.

7085.d: Esiplaanil kõrge kuusk ja põõsad, taamal majad.
7085.de: Tall spruce and bushes in the foreground, houses in the distance.

7117.d: Lühikeste, tumedate juustega noore mehe rinnaportree; pea kerges pöördes paremale. Kulmude vahel sügav kurd, keskendunud pilk suunatud enda ette. Seljas tume kuub, vasakul sinise-musta lindiga rinnale kinnitatud medal.
7117.de: Bust portrait of a young man with short, dark hair; head slightly turned to the right. A deep furrow between the brows, concentrated gaze directed ahead. Wearing a dark coat, with a medal fastened to the chest on the left with a blue-black ribbon.

7147.d: Ateljees asuvate esemete taustal (sirm, pesukauss, kann, ahi, büst), pruuni draperii foonil vasakul toolile nõjatuv naisakt otsevaates, ülakeha pööratud vasakule. Pea toetub tõstetud kõverdatud kätele. Parema, pisut tõstetud kõverdatud jala juures kerratõmbunud musta-valge kirju kass. Maalitud pruunikates summutatud toonides lühikeste pintslilöökidega.
7147.de: Against the background of objects in a studio (screen, washbasin, jug, stove, bust), on a brown drapery background, on the left a female nude leaning on a chair, frontal view, upper body turned to the left. The head rests on raised bent arms. Beside the right, slightly raised bent leg, a black-and-white patched cat curled up. Painted in muted brownish tones with short brushstrokes.

7155.d: Ülaltvaade talvisele puukuuridega hoovile õhtuhämaruses. Paremal viilkatusega maja ots, aia piiril raagus puud. Kaugemal väikesed majad, tulekuma aknais. Silmapiiril, nõlvakul aimatavad puud ja majade siluetid. Maalitud tumedas hallikas-, rohekassinises, punakaspruunis kooriidis kohati värvi pühkivalt, kohati pastoosselt.
7155.de: A bird's-eye view of a winter yard with woodsheds at dusk. On the right, the gable end of a gabled-roof house, bare trees at the fence line. Further off, small houses, the glow of light in their windows. On the horizon, trees and house silhouettes suggested on a slope. Painted in dark greyish-, greenish-blue, reddish-brown tones, in places with sweeping strokes, in places impasto.

7175.d: Noore mehe pea poolprofiilis paremale (üleloomulikus suuruses).
7175.de: Head of a young man in half-profile to the right (in larger-than-life size).

7177.d: Suur pea poolprofiilis paremale, helesinisel taustal.

7342.d: Näpitsprillidega tugitoolis istuva mehe poolfiguur. Pea kerge pöördega paremale. Käed asetatud sülle.
7342.de: Half-figure of a man sitting in an armchair with pince-nez. Head turned slightly to the right. Hands placed in his lap.

7367.d: Hallide seintega toa nurgas pruun neljakandiline taburet, millel beež rätik, valge, musta servaga emailkauss, viimase taga kõhukas, peenikese kaelaga peaaegu täis veepudel. Pudeli ja kausi kõrval esiplaanil kaks roheliste vartega sibulat (varred ripuvad üle tabureti serva), tagaplaanil suur roheline kapsapea. Tabureti taga paremal valge emailämber.
7367.de: In the corner of a room with grey walls, a brown square stool with a beige towel on it, a white enamel bowl with a black rim, behind which stands a bulbous, thin-necked, almost full water bottle. Next to the bottle and bowl in the foreground two onions with green stalks (the stalks hanging over the edge of the stool), in the background a large green cabbage head. Behind the stool on the right a white enamel bucket.

7368.d: Pruunis jakis, beežis pluusis daam, sigaretiga käsi suu juurde tõstetud. Daami nägu heledasti valgustatud, lühikeseks lõigatud juuksed, tilluke pruun kübar viltu peas. Rohelised silmad tillukesed ja pilukil, nina vormikas. Daami ees kõrge klaas ja valge tass. Foon kollakaspruun.
7368.de: A lady in a brown jacket and beige blouse, her hand with a cigarette raised to her mouth. The lady's face is brightly lit, her hair cut short, a tiny brown hat tilted on her head. Her green eyes are tiny and narrowed, her nose shapely. In front of the lady a tall glass and a white cup. The background is yellowish-brown.

7370.d: Vaade läbi avatud uste kolme ruumi. Esiplaanil paremal lauanurk virna ajakirjadega. Keskel vaataja poole avatud kahe poolega valge tahveluks, millest avaneb vaade järgmistesse tubadesse. Keskmises toas vasakul, akna all valge linaga kaetud, sirelibuketiga laud, kõrge seljatoega kolm tooli ümber selle. Paremal paistab osa valgest kahhelahjust. Läbi lahtise ukseava paistab järgmisest ruumist kapinurk ja peegel seinal. Vasakul pool paiknevate akende kaudu langeb päikeselaike põrandale. Detailitäpne sile maalilaad.
7370.de: View through open doors into three rooms. In the foreground on the right the corner of a table with a stack of magazines. In the middle, opening towards the viewer, a white two-leaf panel door, through which a view opens into the next rooms. In the middle room on the left, under the window, a table covered with a white cloth, with a bouquet of lilac, three high-backed chairs around it. On the right part of a white tiled stove is visible. Through the open doorway a cabinet corner and a mirror on the wall are visible in the next room. Through the windows located on the left side patches of sunlight fall on the floor. Detailed, smooth painting style.

7389.d: Esiplaanil paremal sügavalt vetteulatuval neemikul rühm puid ja üksikuid põõsaid. Taamal kõrgenev kallas üksikute põõsastega.
7389.de: In the foreground on the right, on a headland extending deep into the water, a group of trees and individual bushes. In the background a rising shore with individual bushes.

7390.d: Esiplaanil punaka linaga laual sinakas vaasis mitmesuguses värvis lilli. Taustaks poolavatud aken.
7390.de: In the foreground on a table with a reddish cloth, a bluish vase with flowers of various colours. In the background a half-open window.

7404.d: Tühjal lagedal rannal väikesed õlgkatustega kalurimajad, nende vahel kitsas teerada. Vasemal tükike merd, kaldal paadid. Koloriit tume.
7404.de: On an empty open shore small thatched-roof fishermen's houses, with a narrow path between them. On the left a piece of sea, boats on the shore. Dark colouring.

7408.d: Vaade rõduga siseõuele. Paremal rõdu all 2 kattega kaarikut.
7408.de: View of an inner courtyard with a balcony. On the right, under the balcony, 2 covered carts.

7409.de: View from the inner courtyard into the interior of the building.

7410.d: Dekoratsioonikavand "Juudit" II vaatus. Esiplaanil punase draperii all paremal naise, vasakul mehe figuur.
7410.de: Stage design sketch "Juudit" Act II. In the foreground under a red drapery, a woman's figure on the right, a man's figure on the left.

7411.d: Dekoratsioonikavand "Juudit" IV vaatus. Esiplaanil paremal ja vasakul sambad, keskel 4 figuuri. Taamal vaade maastikule.
7411.de: Set design sketch for "Juudit", Act IV. In the foreground columns on the right and left, 4 figures in the centre. A view of a landscape in the distance.

7412.d: Vaade heledalt valgustatud õuest tumedasse võlvialusesse. Võlvialusel astmestikul inimfiguure.
7412.de: View from a brightly lit courtyard into a dark vaulted passage. Human figures on the steps under the vault.

7415.d: Tuba Greco majas Toledos: paremal ja vasemal asemed, keskel laud, tagaseinas 2 akent.
7415.de: A room in Greco's house in Toledo: beds on the right and left, a table in the middle, two windows in the back wall.

7420.d: Esiplaanil künkal suurte kivide vahel katkine paat. Paremal grupp jändrikke, üksteise ümber põimunud mände. Taga meri.
7420.de: In the foreground on a hillock among large stones a broken boat. On the right a group of gnarled pines intertwined with one another. Behind, the sea.

7424.d: Keskel ristilöödud Kristus, vasakul pikas rõivastuses mehe ja naise figuurid.
7424.de: In the centre the crucified Christ, on the left figures of a man and a woman in long garments.

7433.d: Kitsa teeraja ääres tugevatüveliste puude grupp.
7433.de: A group of thick-trunked trees beside a narrow path.

7440.d: Kõrgete müüride vaheline kitsas tänav suundub kaugusse, eredast päikesest valgustatud parem pool, vasakul lillakad varjud. Maali keskosas üle müüri upitavad kaharad puukroonid, nende vahel hele hoone kolme kaarja aknaorvaga paremal. Türkiissinine, kerges pilvevines kirgas taevas.
7440.de: A narrow street between high walls recedes into the distance, the right side lit by bright sunlight, purplish shadows on the left. In the middle of the painting, bushy treetops rise above the wall, and between them a light-coloured building with three arched window niches on the right. The turquoise-blue sky is bright, with a slight haze of clouds.

7453.d: Esiplaanil kuni horisontaalse keskjooneni rohelised ja hallid põllulapid. Rõhtteljel kiviaed, mille taga jätkuvad põllud. Silmapiiril vasakul punase katuse ja kõrge torniga kirik puude keskel, paremal mõned kuused ja üksik mänd. Taevas ülal sinine, üksikute pilvekiududega. Peamiselt rohelistes ja hallides toonides, iga värvipind tumeda joonega ümbritsetud.
7453.de: In the foreground, up to the horizontal midline, green and grey patches of farmland. On the horizontal axis a stone wall, behind which the fields continue. On the horizon, on the left a church with a red roof and a tall tower among the trees, on the right a few spruces and a solitary pine. The sky above is blue, with a few wisps of cloud. Mainly in green and grey tones, each colour area outlined with a dark line.

7461.d: Sinakaslillades tumedates toonides maalitud kahe tuulikuga suvemaastik. Maakividest aed ja tee koonduvad silmapiirile maalitud taluhoonete ning siluetina antud metsaviiru suunas. Erksinises taevas pilvedesse on maalitud loojangukuma ning maastiku hõõguvates toonides pindu.
7461.de: A summer landscape with two windmills, painted in bluish-purple dark tones. A stone-walled garden and a road converge towards the horizon, painted towards farm buildings and a strip of forest given as a silhouette. In the bright blue sky, sunset glow is painted into the clouds, and glowing tones are painted onto surfaces of the landscape.

7462.d: Paremal puude-põõsaste puhmastik, üks puu ülaservani ulatuv. Mõned põõsad õitsevad. Puude vahelt paistab punane katus. Vasakul majanurk, ülaservaga lõigatud; ümber nurga jookseb heledavärviline tee. Tume taevas, allosas helenev. Värv kantud pinnale kohati laiade korrapäraste lüketega.
7462.de: On the right a thicket of trees and bushes, one tree reaching to the upper edge. Some bushes in bloom. Through the trees a red roof is visible. On the left the corner of a house, cut off at the upper edge; a light-coloured road runs around the corner. Dark sky, glowing at the bottom. Paint applied to the surface in places with broad regular strokes.

7464.d: Hõredas täppivas laadis maalitud sügismaastik. Esiplaanil erkpunastes ja -kollastes toonides, juba hõrenenud lehestikuga puud. Vertikaalsest keskjoonest vasakul voolab käänuline jõeke pildi sügavusse, millest kahel pool jõeorg. Horisontaalsest keskjoonest ülalpool paistab läbi puuvõrade helesinine taevas.
7464.de: An autumn landscape painted in a sparse, dotted manner. In the foreground, trees in bright red and yellow tones, foliage already thinned. To the left of the vertical centre line a winding river flows into the depth of the picture, with a river valley on both sides of it. Above the horizontal centre line, a light blue sky is visible through the treetops.

7469.d: Keskosas, õunapuu all, istub pikas rohelises rüüs naine, põlvedel valge lina, sellel istuv laps. Nende ees maas punane õun. Kahel pool ema-last nende poole kummarduvaid, vaatavaid figuure, vasakul kuus, paremal kaheksa inimest. Tagaplaanil kirev maastikuline foon. Maalitud intensiivsetes rohelistes, punastes, pruunides toonides.
7469.de: In the central part, under an apple tree, sits a woman in a long green robe, a white cloth on her knees, a child sitting on it. In front of them on the ground a red apple. On both sides of the mother and child, figures bending toward them and looking, on the left six, on the right eight people. In the background a colourful landscape backdrop. Painted in intense green, red and brown tones.

7470.d: Sinakasrohelises toonis maastiku taustal kuuest alasti seisvast naisest grupp valgete linadega. Kahel vasakpoolsel lina tõstetud peade kõrgusele, ulatub maani. Paremal, naiste jalgade juures pikajalgne pruun koer. Paremal ülemises nurgas diagonaalselt puu tüvi. Figuurid maalitud beežides-pruunides toonides kohati kontuure rõhutades.
7470.de: Against a landscape background in bluish-green tones, a group of six naked standing women with white sheets. On the two left ones the sheet is raised to the height of the head, reaching to the ground. On the right, near the women's feet, a long-legged brown dog. In the upper right corner a tree trunk diagonally. The figures are painted in beige-brown tones, in places emphasising the contours.

7471.d: Vasakul roosakas-punakais ning paremal oleva valkjais-rohekas koloriidis stiliseeritud puu vahelt avaneb vaade künklikule, erksates värvides maastikule.
7471.de: Between a stylised tree, pinkish-red on the left and whitish-greenish on the right in colouring, a view opens onto a hilly landscape in bright colours.

7472.d: Lillakas toonis taeva all paremal kõrge kallas tumerohelise metsatukaga, selle ees punase katusega maja. Vasakul lillakasroosal veel viis purjekat. Maalitud hoogsalt, diagonaalsete pintslilöökidega kohati tugeva faktuuriga.
7472.de: Under a purplish-toned sky, on the right a tall shore with a dark-green clump of forest, in front of it a house with a red roof. On the left, on purplish-pink [water], five more sailboats. Painted spiritedly, with diagonal brushstrokes, in places with strong texture.

7473.d: Erksavärvilise maastiku foonil noore naise rinnaportree otsevaates, pea veidi pööratud paremale, tumedad juuksed seatud tumepunase paelaga. Seljas pidulik mürkroheline õlapaelteta kleit. Parem kõverdatud käsi hoiab õhukest salli ümber õlgade. Maalitud siledalt, diagonaalsete pintslitõmmetega.
7473.de: Against the background of a brightly coloured landscape, a bust portrait of a young woman in a direct view, her head turned slightly to the right, dark hair arranged with a dark red ribbon. She wears a festive poison-green strapless dress. Her bent right arm holds a thin shawl around her shoulders. Painted smoothly, with diagonal brushstrokes.

7474.d: Laia äärega lillas kübaras, punase dekolteeritud kleidis noore naise rinnaportree. Keha poolpöördes vasakule, pea täisprofiilis, parema käega hoiab kübara servast. Taustaks rohekaslilla taeva all tumedas toonis maastik.
7474.de: Chest portrait of a young woman in a wide-brimmed lilac hat, in a red low-cut dress. Body in half-turn to the left, head in full profile, holding the brim of the hat with her right hand. Background a dark-toned landscape under a greenish-lilac sky.

7475.d: Värvilistest püramiididest ja teistest geomeetrilistest kujunditest mägedemotiiv. Maalitud kujundite selgeid vorme rõhutades.
7475.de: A mountain motif made of colourful pyramids and other geometric shapes. Painted emphasising the clear forms of the shapes.

7476.d: Rohekal maastikulisel taustal, tumedates toonides, peaaegu siluetselt lahendatud noore naise poolfiguur otsevaates, pea veidi pööratud paremale. Lahkukammitud pikad juuksed seljal, käed seongus kõhul. Seljas, hõlmad lahti, rohekaspunakas mantel. Maalitud siledalt, pinnaliselt.
7476.de: Against a greenish landscape background, in dark tones, a half-figure of a young woman rendered almost as a silhouette, in a frontal view, head turned slightly to the right. Long, combed-back hair on her back, hands clasped over her stomach. She wears an open greenish-red coat. Painted smoothly, flatly.

7477.d: Rohekashallis koloriidis maalitud kõrgete majadega kaldapealne. Esiplaanil vees, kaarsilla ees punane suitseva korstnaga laev. Maalitud lühikeste tihedate pintslilöökidega.
7477.de: Riverside with tall houses painted in a greenish-grey colour scheme. In the foreground in the water, in front of an arched bridge, a red ship with a smoking chimney. Painted with short dense brushstrokes.

7520.d: Dekoratsioonikavand "Juudit" I vaatusele. Esiplaanil kahe samba vahel kolme astmeline trepp. Keskel kaarvõlvi all seisva ja põlvitava naise figuur. Nende taga ruum kolme kaarja ukseavaga.
7520.de: Set design sketch for Act I of "Juudit". In the foreground, between two columns, a three-step staircase. In the centre, under an arched vault, the figure of a standing and a kneeling woman. Behind them a room with three arched doorways.

7536.d: Kollakates-punakates toonides maastik, maalitud looklevate ja ringlevate pintslilöökidega. Esiplaanil erksinine oja, vasakul maja. Taevas lillades toonides.
7536.de: Landscape in yellowish-reddish tones, painted with winding and circling brushstrokes. In the foreground a bright blue stream, on the left a house. Sky in purple tones.

7646.d: Noore naise poolfiguur, pea pööratud pisut vasemale, pilk vaatlejal, näol leebe naeratus. Parem käsi paigutatud kergelt vasemale. Romantiline, salapärane maastikufoon.
7646.de: Half-figure of a young woman, head turned slightly to the left, gaze on the viewer, a gentle smile on her face. Right hand placed slightly to the left. Romantic, mysterious landscape background.

7653.d: Esiplaanil liivane mererand kaldale uhutus tsisterniga. Taga meri. Horisondil vasakul maariba.
7653.de: In the foreground a sandy seashore with a cistern washed up on the shore. Behind it the sea. On the horizon on the left a strip of land.

7732.d: Ees rida õitsevaid tulpe. Vasakult nurgast diagonaalselt paremale suunduv tee üksikute roheliste põõsastaimedega servadel. Teest vasakul ja paremal peenramaa. Taga paremal väike helesiniseks võõbatud hoone üksikute suurte puudega, vasakul roheline madal puuhoone. Taga keskel kollane hoone. Lilla taevas.
7732.de: In front, a row of blooming tulips. A path leading diagonally from the left corner to the right, with individual green shrubby plants at its edges. To the left and right of the path, a flower bed. Behind, on the right, a small building painted light blue with individual large trees, on the left a green low wooden building. In the middle at the back, a yellow building. Purple sky.

7794.d: Esiplaanil veekogu. Tagapool aeglaselt kõrgenev liivane kallas hõreda okas- ja lehtpuumetsaga. Vee ääres inimgruppe.
7794.de: In the foreground, a body of water. Behind it, a slowly rising sandy shore with sparse coniferous and deciduous forest. Groups of people by the water.

7795.d: Ees vasemal ja keskel veepind suurte peegeldustega, mille taga madal pruun kõrkjane maapind raagus põõsaste ja puurühmaga vasemal ning (tagant võsaga palistatud) väiksema veepinnaga keskel. Paremal roheline nõlvak raagus metsaga. Taga keskel ja paremal raagus mets.
7795.de: In front on the left and in the centre a water surface with large reflections, behind which low brown sedge-covered ground with bare bushes and a group of trees on the left and (bordered behind by scrub) a smaller water surface in the centre. On the right a green slope with bare forest. Behind, in the centre and on the right, bare forest.

7872.d: Vaade Toompeale Snelli tiigi äärest sellise vaatenurga all, et kindlusest on näha vaid Pilstickeri torn.
7872.de: View of Toompea from the edge of Snelli Pond, from an angle such that only the Pilsticker Tower can be seen of the fortress.

7876.d: Pruunil laual vasakul sinisel tikutoosil suitsev sigaret, keskel pooleldi täis pudel ja klaas, nende taga valgel paberil või linal poolik leib ja tükeldatud kala, paremal nuga. Taust tumesinine.
7876.de: On a brown table on the left a smoking cigarette on a blue matchbox, in the middle a half-full bottle and a glass, behind them on white paper or cloth a partial loaf of bread and a cut-up fish, on the right a knife. Dark blue background.

7889.d: Esiplaanil Narva jõepind, mille kaldalt tõuseb Hermani kindlus.
7889.de: In the foreground the surface of the Narva river, from whose bank Hermann Castle rises.

7900.d: Lahtisest aknast avanev vaade üle tänava gooti portaaliga maja fassaadile. Maja üks uksepool on avatud, parempoolsel uksetahvlil ülaossa kinnitatud vaskne silt. Uksest vasakule jääb suur paljude väikeste ruutudega aken. Akna all, paremal kollakas tahvel kirjutisega (J. Ramsalu?). Maali esiplaanil troonivad aknalaual vasakul punaste õitega fuksialaadne potilill, paremal, suuremas potis roheliste nooljate lehtedega toataim.
7900.de: View from an open window across the street to the façade of a house with a Gothic portal. One leaf of the house's door is open, on the right-hand door panel a copper sign fastened at the top. To the left of the door is a large window with many small panes. Below the window, on the right, a yellowish plaque with an inscription (J. Ramsalu?). In the foreground of the painting, enthroned on the windowsill, on the left a fuchsia-like potted plant with red flowers, on the right, in a larger pot, a houseplant with green arrow-shaped leaves.

8066.d: Lühikeseks pöetud juustega pikliku näoga noormehe pea otsevaates. Tõsine ilme, tumedate kontuuridega rõhutatud selged näojooned. Tume koloriit, üldistav maalilaad. Jäme korniline lõuend tausta ja õlgade piirkonnas osaliselt katmata.
8066.de: Head of a young man with a long face and short-cropped hair, in frontal view. Serious expression, clear facial features emphasised with dark contours. Dark colouring, generalising painting manner. Coarse-grained canvas partially left uncovered in the background and shoulder area.

8074.d: Laual esiplaanil tumeda paelaga hele kaabu.
8074.de: In the foreground on the table, a light-coloured hat with a dark ribbon.

8142.d: Esiplaanil kollaka tara ees nokkivad kanad, koerakuut, tara taga kummarduv naine. Tagapool majad, neist üks mitmekorruseline. Hämarduv õhtuvalgus.
8142.de: In the foreground hens pecking in front of a yellowish fence, a doghouse, behind the fence a bending woman. Behind, houses, one of them multi-storeyed. Dusky evening light.

8143.d: Istuva naise poolfiguur, pea poolpöördes paremale. Ülemine näoosa varjus, lõual ja kaelal hele valguselaik. Seljas tume kleit punase kraega.
8143.de: Half-figure of a seated woman, head half-turned to the right. The upper part of the face in shadow, a bright patch of light on the chin and neck. Wearing a dark dress with a red collar.

8144.d: Laual tumedal draperiil kõrvits, suur kauss, purk ja teekann. Paremal heleroheline sein.
8144.de: On a table, on a dark drapery, a pumpkin, a large bowl, a jar and a teapot. On the right a light green wall.

8178.d: Esiplaanil akna all laual tume vaas lilledega. Lauale pudenenud üksikuid suuri punaseid õisi.
8178.de: In the foreground under the window on the table a dark vase with flowers. Individual large red blossoms scattered on the table.

8213.d: Esiplaanil pildi sügavusse suunduv tänav; kahelpool madalad majad. Tänaval kaks inimfiguuri ja koer.
8213.de: In the foreground a street receding into the depth of the picture; on both sides low houses. On the street two human figures and a dog.

8287.d: Ääred muljunud ja määrdunud. Väikeseid pinnakahjustusi

8301.d: Ridamisi istuvad kolm ümaranäolist pikkades punastes rüüdes naist, rätid peas. Kõigil naistel lapsed süles, keskmine toidab last rinnaga. Vasakul äärel osa naljandast figuurist. Maal punakaspruunides toonides siledalt maalitud.(eesti)
8301.de: Sitting in a row, three round-faced women in long red robes, with kerchiefs on their heads. All the women have children in their laps, the middle one is breastfeeding a child. On the left edge, part of a jester figure. The painting is smoothly painted in reddish-brown tones.

8309.d: Keskel paljukäelise ja paljujalalise tantsijanna alasti figuur tantsimas. Tema ümber hiiglasuured tumerohelised lehed ja kasvud. Paremal pool ees hallil lausel jumaluse pea punases toonis rohelise peakattega. Vasakul pool ees sinisel alusel kaks tumedat alasti naisfiguuri. Foon helekollane.
8309.de: In the centre, a nude figure of a dancer with many arms and many legs, dancing. Around her, gigantic dark-green leaves and growths. On the right in front, on a grey slab, the head of a deity in a red tone with a green headdress. On the left in front, on a blue pedestal, two dark nude female figures. The background is light yellow.

8331.d: Valgel alusel vasakul raamat, millel vaas lilledega. Paremal korv õuntega ja kolm banaani. Väga pastoosne.
8331.de: On a white surface, a book on the left with a vase of flowers on it. On the right, a basket with apples and three bananas. Very impasto.

8343.d: Laugjas maastik. Vasakul jõekäär, paremal kirju põõsas. Taamal mets. Taevas hallikas.
8343.de: Gently undulating landscape. On the left a river bend, on the right a variegated bush. Forest in the distance. Sky grayish.

8457.d: Mees ja naine jõesillal. Stiliseeritud vormikäsitlusega kujutisel, esiplaanil, vasakul seisev naine, kerges pöördes vasakule; tumedas, lühikeste varrukatega pluusis ja heledas põlvedeni seelikus, käed külgedel.Temast paremal veidi tagapool, otsevaates seisev mees, käed pükste taskutes, peas kaabu, seljas tume pullover ja veidi tumedamad püksid. Paremal keskel, maja trepil, profiilis paremale seisva inimese figuur. Tagaplaanil jõgi, vasakul kahe mastiga paat, vastaskaldal maju, kaks kõrget suitsevat korstnat.
8457.de: A man and a woman on a river bridge. In a depiction with stylised treatment of form, in the foreground, on the left a standing woman, slightly turned to the left; in a dark, short-sleeved blouse and a light-coloured knee-length skirt, hands at her sides. To her right, somewhat further back, a man standing in frontal view, hands in trouser pockets, a hat on his head, wearing a dark pullover and slightly darker trousers. In the middle right, on the steps of a house, the figure of a person standing in profile facing right. In the background a river, on the left a two-masted boat, on the opposite bank houses, two tall smoking chimneys.

8465.d: Lage, tumedas värvigammas maastik. Ees küntud põlluriba, horisondil seitse puud.Taevas pilveribad. Maalitud hoogsate, laiade pintslilöökidega.
8465.de: Open landscape in a dark colour scheme. In front a ploughed strip of field, on the horizon seven trees. Cloud strips in the sky. Painted with vigorous, broad brushstrokes.

8484.d: Puukiriku madal interjöör, vasakul ja paremal pingid. Tagaplaanil keskel altar.
8484.de: Low interior of a wooden church, pews on the left and right. Altar in the center background.

8487.d: Esiplaanil lage kivisillutis, keskel sammuvaid inimfiguure, tagaplaanil majad; mille ees voorimehed hobustega. Kesksel kohal Tallinna vana raekoda.
8487.de: In the foreground an open stone pavement, in the middle walking human figures, in the background houses, in front of which are cabmen with horses. In the central place, the old Tallinn Town Hall.

8492.d: Tumedates toonides kubistlike vormidega hooned ja laevad. Ees keskel sadamakraana vagonetiga, millest näha vaid tagumine osa. Teine kaubavagonett paistab all paremas nurgas. Maali vasakusse poolde jäävad kaks laeva ning kraana kolmnurkne torn. Suur tumepunane laev on lossimisel. Tema kõrval vasakul asub väike ühe korstnaga alus. Suure laeva kolm korstent paiknevad maali keskosas. Korstnatest tulev suits meenutab tumedavärvilisi kettakesi. Maali värvigammas domineerivad määrdunud sinised, hallid ja lillad toonid.(eesti)
8492.de: Buildings and ships in dark tones with cubist forms. In front, in the centre, a harbour crane with a wagon, of which only the rear part is visible. Another cargo wagon appears in the lower right corner. Two ships and the triangular tower of the crane are in the left half of the painting. A large dark-red ship is being unloaded. Beside it on the left is a small vessel with one funnel. The three funnels of the large ship are located in the central part of the painting. The smoke coming from the funnels resembles dark-coloured discs. Dirty blue, grey and purple tones dominate the painting's colour range.

8522.d: Peenikese jalaga tumesinises vaasis tohutu erinevat liiki roosakasvalgetest ja punastest õitest koosnev lillekimp. Vasakus nurgas ülal on näha osa seinal rippuvast pildist. Foon hallikassinine.
8522.de: In a thin-stemmed dark blue vase, an enormous bouquet of flowers of various kinds in pinkish-white and red. In the upper left corner part of a picture hanging on the wall can be seen. Background greyish-blue.

8544.dm: laius: 99.0 cm (vm); kõrgus: 77.0 cm; kõrgus: 75.5 cm (vm); laius: 100.0 cm
8544.d: Esiplaanil vasakul mänd, kõrval noor kuusk, keskel põõsas. Tagaplaanil lambakari ja lehm väikese karjusetüdrukuga. Taga vasakul ja keskel õlgkatusega taluhooned ja tara; maja taga ning paremal puid. Taevas rünkpilves. Hele koloriit.
8544.de: In the foreground on the left a pine, beside it a young spruce, a bush in the middle. In the background a flock of sheep and a cow with a small shepherd girl. Behind, on the left and in the middle, thatched-roof farm buildings and a fence; trees behind the house and on the right. Cumulus clouds in the sky. Light colouring.

8607.d: Lumine tänav madalate puumajadega paremal. Esiplaanil vasakul lumel tugevad sinised varjud.
8607.de: A snowy street with low wooden houses on the right. In the foreground on the left, strong blue shadows on the snow.

8675.d: Esiplaanil vasakul kaev, suured puud, nööril kuivav pesu. Keskel talumaja, paremal jalgrada.
8675.de: In the foreground on the left a well, large trees, laundry drying on a line. In the centre a farmhouse, on the right a footpath.

8742.d: Tallinna vanalinna vaade, mille esiplaanil Tolli tänav majadega ja tagaplaanil Oleviste kiriku torn.
8742.de: View of Tallinn's Old Town, in the foreground of which Tolli Street with houses and in the background the tower of St Olaf's Church.

8763.d: Akna all laua ääres habemik mees ja lehte lugev naine. Laual mitmesugused tööriistad. Paremal riiul mitmesuguste esemetega, vasakul madal kapp, millel teekann.
8763.de: Under the window, at the table, a bearded man and a woman reading a page. On the table various tools. On the right a shelf with various objects, on the left a low cabinet, on which a teapot.

8794.d: Rangelt geomeetrilisteks pindadeks jaotatud kompositsioon majadest, mille mahud põimudes moodustavad dünaamilise struktuuri, kuhu tungivad kiilutaolised kujundid. Tumedates sinistes, hallides, rohelistes ja mustades toonides.(eesti)
8794.de: A composition strictly divided into geometric planes of houses, whose volumes interlace to form a dynamic structure, into which wedge-like shapes intrude. In dark blue, grey, green and black tones.

8817.d: Ühtlaselt halli talvetaeva taustal lumiste  katustega majad. Peaaegu poole maali pinnast võtavad enda alla esiplaanil olevad külmades värvivarjundeis lumehanged.
8817.de: Against a uniformly grey winter sky, houses with snowy roofs. Almost half the surface of the painting is taken up by the snowdrifts in the foreground, in cold colour shades.

8819.d: Ees vasakul veekogu, milles peegelduvad kaldaäärsed põõsad. Veidi eemal seitse raagus puud ning madal metsaviirg. Koloriit pruunikas - hallides tiinides. Pintslikiri täppiv.
8819.de: In the front on the left a body of water in which the bushes along the shore are reflected. A little further away, seven bare trees and a low strip of forest. Colouring in brownish - grey tones. Precise brushwork.

8830.d: Fantastilise peakattega pea pöördes paremale. Näha sõlmitud juuksepalmik. Ümber stiliseeritud taimi ja lehti.
8830.de: A head with a fantastical headdress, turned to the right. A knotted plait of hair is visible. Surrounded by stylised plants and leaves.

8833.d: Künklik talvine maastik üksikute raagus puudega esiplaanil. Taamal puude vahelt paistab lagedaid künkaid.
8833.de: A hilly winter landscape with solitary bare trees in the foreground. In the distance, bare hills visible among the trees.

8834.d: Kõrge, pruun hobune külgvaates; paremal puu. Taustaks puid.
8834.de: A tall, brown horse in profile; a tree on the right. Trees in the background.

8848.d: Ees, rohumaal kaks lehma ja vasikas. Taga lehtpuumets.(eesti)
8848.de: In front, two cows and a calf on grassland. Behind, deciduous forest.

8849.d: Ees keskel mööda teed vaataja poole sammuv talunaine. Tagapool: paremal roigasaed, õlgkatusega talumaja. Taga vasakul üle plangu paistmas hoone õlgkatus.(eesti)
8849.de: In front, in the centre, a peasant woman walking along the road towards the viewer. Behind: on the right a pole fence, a thatched-roof farmhouse. Further back on the left, the thatched roof of a building visible over the fence.

8868.d: Esiplaanil lumine maapind, maalitud laiade pintslitõmmetega, rõhutades maapinna pisut künklikku profiili; taevas antud sama valkjate pintslilöökidega; keskplaanil männimets, tumedates toonides, sünge, müstiline.
8868.de: In the foreground, snowy ground, painted with broad brushstrokes, emphasizing the slightly hilly profile of the ground; the sky rendered with the same whitish brushstrokes; in the middle ground a pine forest, in dark tones, gloomy, mystical.

8930.d: Esiplaanil vanad õlgkatusega taluhooned puude vahel. Tagaplaanil lumeväljal taluhoone. Silmapiiril metsaviirg, vasakul künkal põlispuud. Paremal üksik teeline reega sõitmas.
8930.de: In the foreground, old thatch-roofed farm buildings among trees. In the background, a farm building on a snow field. On the horizon a strip of forest, on the left on a hillock ancient trees. On the right a lone traveller riding a sledge.

8935.d: Ees keskel ümberlükatud taburett ja laelambist valgustatud laua ümber kolm meest; paremal leti ees seisev mees, vasemal seina ääres seisev mehefiguur.
8935.de: In the centre foreground an overturned stool and three men around a table lit by a ceiling lamp; on the right a man standing at the counter, on the left a male figure standing by the wall.

8936.d: Esiplaanil kividega rand purjekatega, mees- ja naisefiguuridega. Vasakul võrgumaja. Tagaplaanil vasakul sügavalt merre ualtuv neem majade ja metsaga.
8936.de: In the foreground a stony beach with sailboats, with male and female figures. On the left a net house. In the background on the left a headland extending deep into the sea, with houses and forest.

8987.d: Vaibal, tugitooli ees poolprofiilis vasakule seisva tüdruku täisfiguur. Vasakus käes pall, paremas mänguvankri ais.
8987.de: Full figure of a girl standing in half-profile facing left on a carpet in front of an armchair. A ball in her left hand, the shaft of a toy pram in her right.

9031.d: Suvine vaade agulile. Esiplaanil paremal kirikuaiaga ääristatud tee. Aia taga vasakul rukkihakid, kooguga kaev, tagapool kaks rookatusega taluhoonet, punase maja ots. Hoonete taga keskel, pilvise taeva taustal paistab punase kiivriga kirikutorn. Lopsakas pintslikäik, tumeda kontuuriga vorme jälgiv.
9031.de: A summer view of a suburb. In the foreground on the right a road bordered by a churchyard. Behind the fence on the left, sheaves of rye, a well with a sweep, further back two thatched farm buildings, the gable end of a red house. Behind the buildings in the centre, against the backdrop of a cloudy sky, the red-helmeted church tower is visible. Lush brushwork, following forms with dark contours.

9041.d: Päikesepaisteline taluõu: esiplaanil vasakul kooguga kaev, paremal roigasaed ja küüniots. Tagapool matsakas õlgkatusega, palkidest talumaja, millest kahel pool suured rohelised puud. Silmapiiril paremal, kahe hoone vahel, on näha jupike järvest. Ülal sinine, valgete pilvekuhilatega kaetud taevas.(eesti)
9041.de: A sunny farmyard: in the foreground on the left a well with a sweep, on the right a pole fence and the end of a barn. Behind, a stout log farmhouse with a thatched roof, flanked by large green trees. On the horizon on the right, between two buildings, a small piece of a lake can be seen. Above, a blue sky covered with white cloud heaps.

9069.d: Lühikeste, tumedate juustega noore mehe portree, poolpöördes paremale. Suus piip. Ninajuurel sügav kurd; uuriv pilk suunatud vasakule. Kontuur rõhutatud. Koloriidis valdavad sinised-punased värvivarjundid.
9069.de: Portrait of a young man with short, dark hair, in a three-quarter turn to the right. A pipe in his mouth. A deep furrow at the bridge of his nose; a searching gaze directed to the left. The contour is emphasized. The colour scheme is dominated by blue-red hues.

9074.d: Lumine äärelinna tänavanurk, vaadatuna veidi kõrgemalt. Esiplaanil suurte, laotud kivipostide ning sepisvõrega aia ees paremale liikuv grupp musta riietatud neljast naisest: vasakul rauk, tema ees kõnnivad kõrvuti kaks vanemat daami, kõige ees noor naine. Tänavanurgal, eelmisega ristuval tänaval musta riietatud rauk. Tagaplaanil vasakul rohekaspruun hoone, paremal ühekorruselise maja otsafassaad, keskplaanil vasakus kuldlõikes männitüvi. Ümar, pehme, juugendlik vormikäsitlus.
9074.de: A snowy suburban street corner, viewed from slightly above. In the foreground, in front of a fence with large, built-up stone posts and a wrought-iron grille, a group of four women dressed in black moving to the right: on the left an old woman, in front of her two older ladies walking side by side, at the very front a young woman. At the street corner, on the intersecting street, an old woman dressed in black. In the background on the left a greenish-brown building, on the right the end façade of a single-storey house, in the middle ground on the left, in the golden section, a pine trunk. A rounded, soft, Art Nouveau treatment of form.

9120.d: Paremal meri üksikute purjekatega horisondil. Vasakul järve kaljune kallas teda üleval ääristava müüriga. Üle müüri näha leht- ja okaspuude latvu. Horisondil mäeahelik.(eesti)
9120.de: On the right the sea with solitary sailboats on the horizon. On the left a rocky shore of a lake bordered above by a wall. Over the wall the tops of deciduous and coniferous trees can be seen. On the horizon a mountain range.

9190.d: Heledale ookertoonides maapinnale esiplaanil joonistub tumedana raagus puude vari. Keskplaanil puude vahel valgete seintega maja.
9190.de: On a light ochre-toned ground in the foreground the dark shadow of bare trees is drawn. In the middle ground among the trees a house with white walls.

9226.d: Ees valkjatest lilledest ülekülvatud aas. Vasakus servas kask. Selle taga madal, punase katusega, valge pikk hoone. Paremal, maja otsast algab metsaviirg.
9226.de: In front, a meadow strewn with whitish flowers. In the left margin a birch. Behind it a low, long white building with a red roof. On the right, a strip of forest begins at the end of the house.

9227.d: Pruunid potid valgete ja punaste tulpidega. Vasakus servas lillepotid punase, valge ja sinise hüatsindiga.
9227.de: Brown pots with white and red tulips. In the left margin, flowerpots with red, white, and blue hyacinths.

9270.d: Istuva prillidega mehe poolfiguur en face vene kiriku tornide taustal. Peas kõrge valge peakate, üll lilla käisteta rüü, kaelas rist ja ovaalne raha. Vuntsid, hele tömp habe. Käed süles, vasak asetatud rinnale.(eesti)
9270.de: Half-figure of a seated bespectacled man en face against a background of Russian church towers. On his head a tall white headdress, wearing a purple sleeveless robe, on the neck a cross and an oval coin. Moustache, light blunt beard. Hands in the lap, left placed on the chest.

9302.d: Siniste seintega toas, väikesteks ruutudeks jaotatud suure akna all rohelisel toolil istub naine, magav laps süles. Naisel seljas heleroosa kleit, langetatud peas kuklasse sõlme seotud hele rätik. Lapsel seljas valge särgike. Naise jalgade ees korv ja väike jalapink. Aknalaual lillepott.
9302.de: In a room with blue walls, under a large window divided into small squares, a woman sits on a green chair with a sleeping child in her lap. The woman wears a light pink dress, a light kerchief tied in a knot at the nape on her lowered head. The child wears a white shirt. In front of the woman's feet a basket and a small footstool. A flowerpot on the windowsill.

9304.d: Esiplaanil roheline muru, millel paremal valge koer lamamas, pea käpale toetatud. Tema kõrval vasakul seisev punakaspruun koer, pea nuhutamiseks all lastud ning vasak esikäpp tõstetud. Silmapiirist kõrgemal hallikas taevas.
9304.de: In the foreground green grass, on which on the right a white dog lies, head resting on its paw. Beside it on the left a reddish-brown dog standing, head lowered for sniffing, and its left forepaw raised. Above the horizon a greyish sky.

9308.d: Ees lumine maa, keskel üksiku suure puu kõrval skulptuur; taga telliskivist hoone. Paremalt vaade linnamajadele.
9308.de: In front, snowy ground, in the middle a sculpture beside a single large tree; behind, a brick building. On the right a view of city houses.

9332.d: Esiplaanil veekogu ja kaks hobust. Kõrvil pea langetatud; valgel ratsul alasti mehefiguur. Taustaks lage maastik; paremal ja vasakul põõsad. Koloriit tume.
9332.de: In the foreground a body of water and two horses. One with head lowered; on a white steed a nude male figure. Background an open landscape; bushes on the right and left. Dark colouring.

9357.d: Kiilaspäise mehe profiilportree suunaga paremale. Kaela ümber ja õlgadel paistab pruuni mungarüü kaelus ja peakate.
9357.de: Profile portrait of a bald man facing right. Around the neck and on the shoulders, the collar and headgear of a brown monk's habit are visible.

9375.d: Rannal, võrgukuuri nurga juures viiest inimesest grupp: paremal hoogsalt sammuv naine selgvaates, toidukorv vasakus käes, paremas rätt lehvituseks tõstetud; tema kõrval selgvaates mees ja väike tüdruk kaugemal rannajoonel paistvale purjekale järele vaatamas. Esiplaanil vasakul külgvaates põlvitav poiss ja tüdruk võrke parandamas. Küpsed beežid, pruunid, sinised toonid, ümarselgselt vorme välja maaliv laad.(eesti)
9375.de: On the beach, by the corner of a net shed, a group of five people: on the right a briskly walking woman seen frontally, a food basket in her left hand, a kerchief raised in her right hand for waving; next to her a man seen frontally and a small girl, further along the shoreline, watching a sailboat that is visible. In the foreground on the left a kneeling boy and girl seen in profile, mending nets. Mature beige, brown, blue tones, a style painting forms out with rounded clarity.

9509.d: Ees noor tumedajuukseline naine, kes paljast ihu varjab rindadeni tõstetud valge riidega. Keskse kuju kõrval ja taga tema poole vaatavad inimfiguurid. Foon oranžikas-kollane.
9509.de: In front, a young dark-haired woman covering her bare body up to the breasts with a white cloth. Beside and behind the central figure, human figures looking toward her. The background is orangish-yellow.

9532.d: Naise portree profiilis vasakule, peakattes, valge žabooga. Foon hele. Pastoosselt maalitud.
9532.de: Portrait of a woman in profile to the left, wearing headwear, with a white jabot. Light background. Painted impasto.

9570.d: Kollasel laual keskel tumesinine keraamiline vaas suurte daaliate, jorjenite, krüsanteemide jt. hilissuviste lillede kimbuga. Vaasist vasakul kaks õuna ja kolm banaani, paremal servas kaks karpi, küünlajalg, tikutoosihoidja. Foon sinakashall, paremalt servast punane.
9570.de: In the centre of a yellow table a dark blue ceramic vase with a bouquet of large dahlias, gerberas, chrysanthemums and other late-summer flowers. To the left of the vase two apples and three bananas, on the right edge two boxes, a candlestick, a matchbox holder. Background bluish-grey, red from the right edge.

9571.d: Noore tüdruku portree. Nägu ookertoonides, suured silmad, lühikestel juustel laiaääreline õlgkübar. Seljas valge kraega helepunane pluus ja hallikas jakk.
9571.de: Portrait of a young girl. Face in ochre tones, large eyes, on short hair a wide-brimmed straw hat. Wearing a light red blouse with a white collar and a grayish jacket.

9609.d: Tumedajuukselise naise rinnapilt punases mantlis. Küünarnukkidele toetuvaile ristatud kätele toetuv pea pööratud kergelt vasemale. Taustaks ruuduline kangas.
9609.de: Bust portrait of a dark-haired woman in a red coat. Her head, resting on crossed arms propped on the elbows, is turned slightly to the left. Checked fabric as background.

9611.dm: kõrgus: 53.0 cm (vm  ); laius: 72.0 cm (arm  ); laius: 71.0 cm (vm ); kõrgus: 54.7 cm (arm  )
9611.d: Esiplaanil tahapoole suunduv tee, vasakul aed, mille taga raagus kased ja maja. Keskel tagapool okaspuid ja kaski. Paremal heinamaa, maja ja puid. Kauguses mets.
9611.de: In the foreground a road leading into the distance, on the left a garden, behind which are bare birches and a house. In the middle, further back, conifers and birches. On the right a meadow, a house and trees. A forest in the distance.

9617.d: Mehe rindportree tumedas palitus üleskeeratud kraega. Peas roheline kaabu. Vasakus kinnastatud käes jalutuskepp konksuga vastu õlga.
9617.de: Bust portrait of a man in a dark coat with a turned-up collar. On his head a green hat. In his gloved left hand a walking stick with a hook resting against his shoulder.

9734.d: Hallikaspruunides ja rohelistes toonides suvine agulivaade sillutatamta tänavaga esiplaanil. Sellest vasakul üksteise külge ehitatud hallid agulimajad põõsastega seina ääres ja sinistest lippidest tara eraldamaks väikest aeda. Teest paremal põõsad, otse paar suuremat pruuni maja. Ülal, läbi hõrdeda roheluse paistev kollakashall taevas. Maalitud pastoosselt, kohati pintslivart või puupulka kasutades.
9734.de: A summer suburban view in greyish-brown and green tones with an unpaved street in the foreground. To its left grey suburban houses built against one another with bushes along the wall and a fence of blue slats separating a small garden. To the right of the road bushes, directly behind them a couple of larger brown houses. Above, a yellowish-grey sky showing through sparse greenery. Painted pastosely, in places using the butt end of a brush or a wooden stick.

9768.d: Pildi alumises servas patsiga naise rinnafiguur ning roheline vaas. Tagapool kolm mehe poolfiguuri. Tagumisel mehel suitsev piip suus. Koloriit summutatud, ülekaalus sinakad toonid.(eesti)
9768.de: At the bottom edge of the picture the bust of a woman with a braid and a green vase. Behind, three half-length figures of men. The rearmost man has a smoking pipe in his mouth. The colour scheme is muted, bluish tones predominate.

9804.d: Keskealise naise rinnaportree otsevaates. Tumedad juuksed, kitsad kulmukaared ja suu, lihav nina, lohkuvajunud põsed. Seljas tumeda kraega punane riietusese valge maniskiga, millel suured nööbid. Foon heleroheline.
9804.de: Chest portrait of a middle-aged woman, frontal view. Dark hair, narrow eyebrow arches and mouth, fleshy nose, sunken cheeks. Wearing a red garment with a dark collar and a white cuff with large buttons. Background light green.

9825.d: Tumedal künklikul maastikul esiplaanil vasakul valge hobune selgvaates, paremal viis lammast söömas. Tagaplaanil üksikud kivid, paremal jändrik mänd. Silmapiiril üksikud puud rünkpilvise taeva taustal. Maalitud täppivalt, pastoosselt.
9825.de: On a dark hilly landscape, in the foreground on the left a white horse in profile, on the right five sheep grazing. In the background solitary stones, on the right a stunted pine. On the horizon solitary trees against a background of a cumulus-cloud sky. Painted in dabs, pastosely.

9826.dm: kõrgus: 100.0 cm; laius: 96.0 cm; laius: 101.0 cm; kõrgus: 96.0 cm
9826.d: Värvilistel ja mustrilistel draperiidel natüürmort: kõrge vaas tumesinise jala ja ülaosaga; vaas tugevalt paisuva keskosaga, sangad sissepoole pööratud; all taldrikul ja draperiil suured õunad.
9826.de: A still life on colourful and patterned drapery: a tall vase with a dark blue foot and upper part; the vase with a strongly bulging middle section, the handles turned inward; below, on a plate and on the drapery, large apples.

9849.d: Esiplaanil maapinaale langev jändriku puu vari. Pildi keskel jändrik raagus puu. Maapinnal üksikuid lumelaike.
9849.de: In the foreground the shadow of a gnarled tree falling on the ground. In the centre of the picture a gnarled bare tree. Solitary patches of snow on the ground.

9861.dm: laius: 97.0 cm; kõrgus: 76.3 cm (arm   ); kõrgus: 76.5 cm; laius: 96.4 cm (arm   )
9861.d: Varjus asuval esiplaanil suured lehtpuud. Nende vahelt paistab puude vahel asetsev ühekordne, väikeste akendega hoone, osaliselt heledas päikesevalguses.
9861.de: Large deciduous trees in the shaded foreground. Between them a single-storey building with small windows is visible, situated among the trees, partly in bright sunlight.

9881.d: Tänav madalate majadega. Vasakul mõned suured puud ja inimfiguurid. Kauguses paistab puude vahelt kirikutorn.
9881.de: A street with low houses. On the left some large trees and human figures. In the distance, a church tower can be seen through the trees.

9882.d: Tagaplaanil kaks tumepruuni puumaja. Nende ees õuel kaks hobust regedega: vasakul tumedas varjupoolses osas pruun hobune, paremal päikesepaistes helekollane hobune. Majade katustel ja parempoolse maja juures pisut lund. Paremal kaks puud. Taustaks soojalt kumav sinine.
9882.de: In the background, two dark brown wooden houses. In front of them in the yard, two horses with sledges: on the left, in the dark, shaded area, a brown horse, on the right, in sunshine, a light yellow horse. A little snow on the roofs of the houses and near the house on the right. On the right, two trees. The background a warmly glowing blue.

9885.d: Esiplaanil tahapoole nõjatuv seisev naisakt, parem käsi ülestõstetult kukalt toetamas, nägu välja maalimata. Pehmetes toon-toonile üleminekutes maalitud figuuri taustaks tumedad hallid, pruunid ja mustad seina- ning põrandapinnad.
9885.de: In the foreground, a standing female nude leaning backward, right hand raised supporting the back of the head, face left unpainted. The figure painted in soft tone-on-tone transitions, against a background of dark grey, brown and black wall and floor surfaces.

9934.d: Istuv naine oranžis kleidis, valge salliga.
9934.de: A seated woman in an orange dress, with a white shawl.

9977.d: Ookerpruunil taustal mustjaspruunis kuldse ääristusega rüüs naine Kristuslapsega vasakul käel, parem käsi õnnistuseks tõstetud. Kristuslapsel roheline - kuldne rüü seljas, mõlemal kuldne nimbus ümber pea. Jumalaema pea kõrval vasakul ja paremal ning Kristuse pea kohal valgega maalitud sümbolid kirillitsas. Ikooni külgedel üksteise all kujutatud neli pühakut: vasakul ülal märter Nikita küti atribuutidega, tema all püha Simeon punases - sinises rüüs. Paremal äärel ülal märter Agafia, all püha Marfa tumedas keebis, rohekas rüü selle all. Ääre figuuridel kuldsed nimbused ümber pea, nimed kujutatu kohal.
9977.de: On an ochre-brown background, a woman in a blackish-brown robe with a gold border, with the Christ Child on her left arm, her right hand raised in blessing. The Christ Child wears a green-gold robe, and both figures have a gold nimbus around the head. To the left and right of the Mother of God's head, and above Christ's head, symbols painted in white in Cyrillic script. On the sides of the icon, four saints are depicted one below the other: upper left, the martyr Nikita with the attributes of a hunter, below him Saint Simeon in a red-blue robe. On the right edge, upper, the martyr Agatha, below, Saint Martha in a dark cloak with a greenish robe beneath it. The figures on the edge have gold nimbuses around their heads, with their names above the depicted figures.

9978.d: Vana mehe poolfiguur en face istuvas asendis. Hall habe, paljas pea, käed ees ristatult. Tagant paistab toolileen.(eesti)
9978.de: Half-figure of an old man en face in a seated position. Grey beard, bald head, hands crossed in front. A chair back visible behind him.

10039.d: Hallide seintega toa nurgas istub tumedal toolil punakaspruunis kleidis, valge põllega tütarlaps. Tüdruku juuksed on sirged ja langevad kõrvadele, käed puhkavad teineteise kõrval süles. Tüdruku jalas mustad sukad ja kingad, kurbade silmadega pilk vastasnurka suunatud. Tüdrukust paremalt näha osa seina äärde lükatud lauast, mille kohal seinal ripub arvatavasti pilt.
10039.de: In the corner of a room with grey walls sits a girl in a reddish-brown dress with a white apron, on a dark chair. The girl's hair is straight and falls to her ears, her hands rest side by side in her lap. The girl wears black stockings and shoes, her gaze with sad eyes directed at the opposite corner. To the right of the girl, part of a table pushed against the wall is visible, above which a picture presumably hangs on the wall.

10041.d: Osa tänavast viilkatusega majadega, nende tagant paistab Oleviste torn.
10041.de: Part of a street with gabled houses, behind which the tower of Oleviste is visible.

10047.d: Kallakuga katuseateljee akna taustal, valgel alusel keskplaanil diagonaalselt reastatult lillepottides kasvavad krüsanteemid, keskel maali ülemise ääreni ulatuv roosakasvalge, sellest paremal veidi lühem sinakasvalge krüsanteem. Esiplaanil vasakul maali alaääre poolt äralõigatud potis mitu väikest valget õit.
10047.de: Against the background of a window in a sloped-roof studio, in the middle ground on a white base, chrysanthemums growing in flowerpots arranged diagonally, in the centre a pinkish-white one reaching to the upper edge of the painting, to its right a slightly shorter bluish-white chrysanthemum. In the foreground on the left, in a pot cut off by the lower edge of the painting, several small white blossoms.

10049.d: Pruunil, tumeda kontuurjoonega markeeritud laual natüürmort: vasakult alates valge tass, sai, kaelast katkine vaas, punakaspruun peeker, must pudel ja sidrun paremal esiplaanil. Fooniks vasakul sinakashall draperii, paremal helehall sein.
10049.de: On a brown table marked with a dark contour line, a still life: from the left, a white cup, bread, a vase broken at the neck, a reddish-brown mug, a black bottle and a lemon in the right foreground. The background on the left is a bluish-grey drapery, on the right a light grey wall.

10075.d: Istuva vanema mehe figuur poolpöördes vasakule. Kuldraamidega prillid, õlgadeni juuksed, vuntsid, tömp hele habe. Peas kõrge valge peakate. Seljas rohekas rüü laiade käistega, valged kätised. Käed süles risti. Kaelas rist ja ovaalne raha. Foon hallikas-lilla.
10075.de: Figure of a seated elderly man in a half-turn to the left. Gold-framed glasses, shoulder-length hair, moustache, blunt light beard. On his head a tall white headdress. Wearing a greenish robe with wide sleeves, white cuffs. Hands crossed in his lap. A cross and an oval coin on his neck. Grayish-purple background.

10093.d: Suur mehe täisfiguur seljaga vaataja poole, ümbritsetud mitmesugustest lindudest. Paremal raagus puu lindudega.
10093.de: Large full figure of a man with his back to the viewer, surrounded by various birds. On the right a bare tree with birds.

10099.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 96.0 cm; kujutise laius: 80.8 cm
10099.d: Kaks mehefiguuri jämedat põikhooba lükkamas. Parempoolne alasti, maalitud rohekais toonides. Foon tume.
10099.de: Two male figures pushing a thick crossbar lever. The one on the right is nude, painted in greenish tones. Background dark.

10136.d: Esiplaanil paremal neljast sambaga rõdu nurk. Keskel väljak, mida piiravad paremalt elumajad, vasakult raekoda. Paremal hoburakend. Raekoja tagakülje ees kaks hoburakendit selgvaates, üks profiilis vasakule.(eesti)
10136.de: In the foreground on the right, the corner of a balcony with four columns. In the centre, a square bounded on the right by residential buildings, on the left by the town hall. On the right, a horse-drawn carriage. In front of the rear side of the town hall, two horse-drawn carriages in three-quarter view, one in profile facing left.

10180.d: Esiplaanil eest taha suunduv teerada. Tagapool põõsastik ja puud.
10180.de: In the foreground a path leading from front to back. Shrubbery and trees behind.

10206.d: Esiplaanil käärdus paremalt vasakule sügavusse suunduv jõgi, kallastel vees peegelduvaid lehtpuid ja põõsaid, tagaplaanil künklik maastik puudesaludega.
10206.de: In the foreground a river winding from right to left into the depth, on its banks deciduous trees and bushes reflected in the water, in the background a hilly landscape with groves.

10207.d: Keskealise daami portree, kolmveerandfiguur, peaaegu en face, keha kerge pöördega vasakule. Taustaks kirju vaip.
10207.de: Portrait of a middle-aged lady, three-quarter figure, almost en face, body slightly turned to the left. Background a patterned carpet.

10211.d: Kuuli tõukava väikestes sportpükstes mehe täisfiguur poolprofiilis paremale. Parem käsi kuuliga õla juures.(eesti)
10211.de: Full figure of a man in small sports shorts putting the shot, in half-profile to the right. Right hand with the shot at shoulder level.

10241.d: Vasakul ja paremal rohelised puud ja põõsad. Vasakul tagapool näha kosk ja jõgi, mis diagonaalselt suundub esiplaanil paremale.
10241.de: Green trees and bushes on the left and right. In the back on the left a waterfall and a river are visible, running diagonally toward the foreground on the right.

10266.d: Esiplaanil kaks inimeste gruppi: vasakul kolmest inimesest koosnev grupp, paremal hulk inimesi, korvidega istuv naine kõige ees. Inimestest viib tee pildi sügavusse, teest kahel pool ümaralt antud tumerohelised puud ja põõsad. Tagaplaanil taeva taustal puude vahel suure geomeetrilise üldistatusega antud majad. Maalitud kohati üksteisesse sulavates, sügavates värvitoonides.
10266.de: In the foreground two groups of people: on the left a group of three people, on the right a number of people, a woman with baskets sitting at the very front.
